transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I was advised to come speak with someone. I'm not entirely sure a doctor is what I need, but... it's regarding a situation at my residence. 

For months now, the property manager and certain people in the building have been... well, they've been trying to pressure me out of my apartment. I'd really rather not get into all the petty details, but it's a constant pattern. Mail being misdelivered on purpose, noises in the walls that are timed perfectly to disturb me... little comments from the neighbors when I walk by. 

Whenever I bring it up, they just hand me paperwork or offer these empty explanations. But... I analyze things for a living. No amount of their excuses changes the pattern I can clearly see.
Aside from the noises you hear in the walls, have you ever heard voices or seen things that others around you do not seem to notice?

No. I don't... hear voices. Nothing like that. 

It's just the noises they make in the walls, like I mentioned. I haven't seen anything that isn't actually there, if that's what you're asking. Just... what I've already told you.
